audit_status.review_note: Alphabetic acrostic, Torah, instruction, affliction, justice, meditation, persecution, and longing.

verses.restored: Blessed are those whose way is whole, who walk in the Torah of YHWH.

familiar.text: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.

notes.title: Torah and acrostic
notes.body: Psalm 119 is an eightfold alphabetic acrostic organized around Torah and overlapping terms for instruction, command, testimony, statute, and word. Torah here is lived divine teaching, not merely a synonym for punitive legalism.

modern.text: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.

original.text: אַשְׁרֵ֥י תְמִֽימֵי דָ֑רֶךְ הַֽ֝הֹלְכִ֗ים בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

familiar.text: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

modern.text: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.

original.text: אַ֭שְׁרֵי נֹצְרֵ֥י עֵדֹתָ֗יו בְּכָל לֵ֥ב יִדְרְשֽׁוּהוּ

verses.restored: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

familiar.text: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

modern.text: They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.

original.text: אַ֭ף לֹֽא פָעֲל֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה בִּדְרָכָ֥יו הָלָֽכוּ

verses.restored: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.

familiar.text: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.

modern.text: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.

original.text: אַ֭תָּה צִוִּ֥יתָה פִקֻּדֶ֗יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְאֹֽד

verses.restored: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

familiar.text: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

modern.text: Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes!

original.text: אַ֭חֲלַי יִכֹּ֥נוּ דְרָכָ֗י לִשְׁמֹ֥ר חֻקֶּֽיךָ

verses.restored: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect to all thy commandments.

familiar.text: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

modern.text: Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.

original.text: אָ֥ז לֹא אֵב֑וֹשׁ בְּ֝הַבִּיטִ֗י אֶל כָּל מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

familiar.text: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

modern.text: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.

original.text: א֭וֹדְךָ בְּיֹ֣שֶׁר לֵבָ֑ב בְּ֝לָמְדִ֗י מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ

verses.restored: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

familiar.text: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

modern.text: I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me. BETH

original.text: אֶת חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶשְׁמֹ֑ר אַֽל תַּעַזְבֵ֥נִי עַד מְאֹֽד

verses.restored: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

familiar.text: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

modern.text: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.

original.text: בַּמֶּ֣ה יְזַכֶּה נַּ֭עַר אֶת אָרְח֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ

verses.restored: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

familiar.text: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

modern.text: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.

original.text: בְּכָל לִבִּ֥י דְרַשְׁתִּ֑יךָ אַל תַּ֝שְׁגֵּ֗נִי מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

familiar.text: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

modern.text: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.

original.text: בְּ֭לִבִּי צָפַ֣נְתִּי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֶֽחֱטָא לָֽךְ

verses.restored: Blessed art thou, O YHWH: teach me thy statutes.

familiar.text: Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.

modern.text: Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.

original.text: בָּר֖וּךְ אַתָּ֥ה יְהוָ֗ה לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ

verses.restored: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

familiar.text: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

modern.text: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.

original.text: בִּשְׂפָתַ֥י סִפַּ֑רְתִּי כֹּ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵי פִֽיךָ

verses.restored: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

familiar.text: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

modern.text: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.

original.text: בְּדֶ֖רֶךְ עֵדְוֺתֶ֥יךָ שַׂ֗שְׂתִּי כְּעַ֣ל כָּל הֽוֹן

verses.restored: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect to thy ways.

familiar.text: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

modern.text: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.

original.text: בְּפִקֻּדֶ֥יךָ אָשִׂ֑יחָה וְ֝אַבִּ֗יטָה אֹרְחֹתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

familiar.text: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

modern.text: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word. GIMEL

original.text: בְּחֻקֹּתֶ֥יךָ אֶֽשְׁתַּעֲשָׁ֑ע לֹ֭א אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח דְּבָרֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.

familiar.text: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.

modern.text: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.

original.text: גְּמֹ֖ל עַֽל עַבְדְּךָ֥ אֶֽחְיֶ֗ה וְאֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה דְבָרֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

familiar.text: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

modern.text: Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.

original.text: גַּל עֵינַ֥י וְאַבִּ֑יטָה נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת מִתּוֹרָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

familiar.text: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

modern.text: I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.

original.text: גֵּ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י בָאָ֑רֶץ אַל תַּסְתֵּ֥ר מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath to thy judgments at all times.

familiar.text: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.

modern.text: My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.

original.text: גָּרְסָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣י לְתַאֲבָ֑ה אֶֽל מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ בְכָל עֵֽת

verses.restored: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

familiar.text: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

modern.text: You rebuke the arrogant— the cursed who stray from Your commandments.

original.text: גָּ֭עַרְתָּ זֵדִ֣ים אֲרוּרִ֑ים הַ֝שֹּׁגִים מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

familiar.text: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

modern.text: Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.

original.text: גַּ֣ל מֵֽ֭עָלַי חֶרְפָּ֣ה וָב֑וּז כִּ֖י עֵדֹתֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי

verses.restored: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

familiar.text: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

modern.text: Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.

original.text: גַּ֤ם יָֽשְׁב֣וּ שָׂ֭רִים בִּ֣י נִדְבָּ֑רוּ עַ֝בְדְּךָ֗ יָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּחֻקֶּֽיךָ

verses.restored: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.

familiar.text: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.

modern.text: Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors. DALETH

original.text: גַּֽם עֵ֭דֹתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֗י אַנְשֵׁ֥י עֲצָתִֽי

verses.restored: My soul cleaveth to the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

familiar.text: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

modern.text: My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.

original.text: דָּֽבְקָ֣ה לֶעָפָ֣ר נַפְשִׁ֑י חַ֝יֵּ֗נִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ

verses.restored: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

familiar.text: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

modern.text: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.

original.text: דְּרָכַ֣י סִ֭פַּרְתִּי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֗נִי לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ

verses.restored: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

familiar.text: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

modern.text: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.

original.text: דֶּֽרֶךְ פִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ הֲבִינֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָשִׂ֗יחָה בְּנִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according to thy word.

familiar.text: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

modern.text: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.

original.text: דָּלְפָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִתּוּגָ֑ה קַ֝יְּמֵ֗נִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

familiar.text: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

modern.text: Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law.

original.text: דֶּֽרֶךְ שֶׁ֭קֶר הָסֵ֣ר מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ֥ חָנֵּֽנִי

verses.restored: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.

familiar.text: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.

modern.text: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.

original.text: דֶּֽרֶךְ אֱמוּנָ֥ה בָחָ֑רְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ שִׁוִּֽיתִי

verses.restored: I have stuck to thy testimonies: O YHWH, put me not to shame.

familiar.text: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.

modern.text: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.

original.text: דָּבַ֥קְתִּי בְעֵֽדְוֺתֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַל תְּבִישֵֽׁנִי

verses.restored: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

familiar.text: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

modern.text: I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart. HE

original.text: דֶּֽרֶךְ מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אָר֑וּץ כִּ֖י תַרְחִ֣יב לִבִּֽי

verses.restored: Teach me, O YHWH, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it to the end.

familiar.text: Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.

modern.text: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.

original.text: הוֹרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ חֻקֶּ֗יךָ וְאֶצְּרֶ֥נָּה עֵֽקֶב

verses.restored: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

familiar.text: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

modern.text: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.

original.text: הֲ֭בִינֵנִי וְאֶצְּרָ֥ה תֽוֹרָתֶ֗ךָ וְאֶשְׁמְרֶ֥נָּה בְכָל לֵֽב

verses.restored: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

familiar.text: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

modern.text: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.

original.text: הַ֭דְרִיכֵנִי בִּנְתִ֣יב מִצְוֺתֶ֑יךָ כִּי ב֥וֹ חָפָֽצְתִּי

verses.restored: Incline my heart to thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

familiar.text: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

modern.text: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.

original.text: הַט לִ֭בִּי אֶל עֵדְוֺתֶ֗יךָ וְאַ֣ל אֶל בָּֽצַע

verses.restored: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.

familiar.text: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.

modern.text: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.

original.text: הַעֲבֵ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי מֵרְא֣וֹת שָׁ֑וְא בִּדְרָכֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי

verses.restored: Stablish thy word to thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.

familiar.text: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.

modern.text: Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.

original.text: הָקֵ֣ם לְ֭עַבְדְּךָ אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לְיִרְאָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.

familiar.text: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.

modern.text: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.

original.text: הַעֲבֵ֣ר חֶ֭רְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָגֹ֑רְתִּי כִּ֖י מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ טוֹבִֽים

verses.restored: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

familiar.text: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

modern.text: How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness. WAW

original.text: הִ֭נֵּה תָּאַ֣בְתִּי לְפִקֻּדֶ֑יךָ בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי

verses.restored: Let thy mercies come also to me, O YHWH, even thy salvation, according to thy word.

familiar.text: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.

modern.text: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.

original.text: וִֽיבֹאֻ֣נִי חֲסָדֶ֣ךָ יְהוָ֑ה תְּ֝שֽׁוּעָתְךָ֗ כְּאִמְרָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.

familiar.text: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.

modern.text: Then I can answer him who taunts, for I trust in Your word.

original.text: וְאֶֽעֱנֶ֣ה חֹרְפִ֣י דָבָ֑ר כִּֽי בָ֝טַחְתִּי בִּדְבָרֶֽךָ

verses.restored: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

familiar.text: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

modern.text: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.

original.text: וְֽאַל תַּצֵּ֬ל מִפִּ֣י דְבַר אֱמֶ֣ת עַד מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֖י לְמִשְׁפָּטֶ֣ךָ יִחָֽלְתִּי

verses.restored: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

familiar.text: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

modern.text: I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.

original.text: וְאֶשְׁמְרָ֖ה תוֹרָתְךָ֥ תָמִ֗יד לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד

verses.restored: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

familiar.text: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

modern.text: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.

original.text: וְאֶתְהַלְּכָ֥ה בָרְחָבָ֑ה כִּ֖י פִקֻּדֶ֣יךָ דָרָֽשְׁתִּי

verses.restored: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

familiar.text: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

modern.text: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.

original.text: וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְ֭עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶ֥גֶד מְלָכִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ

verses.restored: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

familiar.text: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

modern.text: I delight in Your commandments because I love them.

original.text: וְאֶשְׁתַּֽעֲשַׁ֥ע בְּמִצְוֺתֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהָֽבְתִּי

verses.restored: My hands also will I lift up to thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.

familiar.text: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.

modern.text: I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes. ZAYIN

original.text: וְאֶשָּֽׂא כַפַּ֗י אֶֽל מִ֭צְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהָ֗בְתִּי וְאָשִׂ֥יחָה בְחֻקֶּֽיךָ

verses.restored: Remember the word to thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

familiar.text: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

modern.text: Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope.

original.text: זְכֹר דָּבָ֥ר לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ עַ֝֗ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽחַלְתָּֽנִי

verses.restored: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

familiar.text: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

modern.text: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.

original.text: זֹ֣את נֶחָמָתִ֣י בְעָנְיִ֑י כִּ֖י אִמְרָתְךָ֣ חִיָּֽתְנִי

verses.restored: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.

familiar.text: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.

modern.text: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.

original.text: זֵ֭דִים הֱלִיצֻ֣נִי עַד מְאֹ֑ד מִ֝תּֽוֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי

verses.restored: I remembered thy judgments of old, O YHWH; and have comforted myself.

familiar.text: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.

modern.text: I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD, and in them I find comfort.

original.text: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶ֖יךָ מֵעוֹלָ֥ם יְהוָ֗ה וָֽאֶתְנֶחָֽם

verses.restored: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

familiar.text: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

modern.text: Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law.

original.text: זַלְעָפָ֣ה אֲ֭חָזַתְנִי מֵרְשָׁעִ֑ים עֹ֝זְבֵ֗י תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

familiar.text: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

modern.text: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.

original.text: זְ֭מִרוֹת הָֽיוּ לִ֥י חֻקֶּ֗יךָ בְּבֵ֣ית מְגוּרָֽי

verses.restored: I have remembered thy name, O YHWH, in the night, and have kept thy law.

familiar.text: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.

modern.text: In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.

original.text: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וָֽ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.

familiar.text: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.

modern.text: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts. HETH

original.text: זֹ֥את הָֽיְתָה לִּ֑י כִּ֖י פִקֻּדֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי

verses.restored: Thou art my portion, O YHWH: I have said that I would keep thy words.

familiar.text: Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.

modern.text: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.

original.text: חֶלְקִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אָמַ֗רְתִּי לִשְׁמֹ֥ר דְּבָרֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful to me according to thy word.

familiar.text: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.

modern.text: I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.

original.text: חִלִּ֣יתִי פָנֶ֣יךָ בְכָל לֵ֑ב חָ֝נֵּ֗נִי כְּאִמְרָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet to thy testimonies.

familiar.text: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

modern.text: I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies.

original.text: חִשַּׁ֥בְתִּי דְרָכָ֑י וָאָשִׁ֥יבָה רַ֝גְלַ֗י אֶל עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

familiar.text: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

modern.text: I hurried without hesitating to keep Your commandments.

original.text: חַ֭שְׁתִּי וְלֹ֣א הִתְמַהְמָ֑הְתִּי לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.

familiar.text: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.

modern.text: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law.

original.text: חֶבְלֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים עִוְּדֻ֑נִי תּֽ֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי

verses.restored: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to thee because of thy righteous judgments.

familiar.text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.

modern.text: At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.

original.text: חֲצֽוֹת לַ֗יְלָה אָ֭קוּם לְהוֹד֣וֹת לָ֑ךְ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ

verses.restored: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

familiar.text: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

modern.text: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.

original.text: חָבֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי לְכָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְרֵא֑וּךָ וּ֝לְשֹׁמְרֵ֗י פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: The earth, O YHWH, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.

familiar.text: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.

modern.text: The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes. TETH

original.text: חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֗רֶץ חֻקֶּ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי

verses.restored: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O YHWH, according to thy word.

familiar.text: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.

modern.text: You are good to Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.

original.text: ט֭וֹב עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִֽם עַבְדְּךָ֑ יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

familiar.text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

modern.text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.

original.text: ט֤וּב טַ֣עַם וָדַ֣עַת לַמְּדֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י בְמִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ הֶאֱמָֽנְתִּי

verses.restored: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

familiar.text: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

modern.text: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.

original.text: טֶ֣רֶם אֶ֭עֱנֶה אֲנִ֣י שֹׁגֵ֑ג וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה אִמְרָתְךָ֥ שָׁמָֽרְתִּי

verses.restored: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

familiar.text: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

modern.text: You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.

original.text: טוֹב אַתָּ֥ה וּמֵטִ֗יב לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ

verses.restored: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.

familiar.text: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.

modern.text: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.

original.text: טָפְל֬וּ עָלַ֣י שֶׁ֣קֶר זֵדִ֑ים אֲ֝נִ֗י בְּכָל לֵ֤ב אֱצֹּ֬ר פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.

familiar.text: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.

modern.text: Their hearts are hard and callous, but I delight in Your law.

original.text: טָפַ֣שׁ כַּחֵ֣לֶב לִבָּ֑ם אֲ֝נִ֗י תּוֹרָתְךָ֥ שִֽׁעֲשָֽׁעְתִּי

verses.restored: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

familiar.text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

modern.text: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.

original.text: טֽוֹב לִ֥י כִֽי עֻנֵּ֑יתִי לְ֝מַ֗עַן אֶלְמַ֥ד חֻקֶּֽיךָ

verses.restored: The law of thy mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver.

familiar.text: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

modern.text: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH

original.text: טֽוֹב לִ֥י תֽוֹרַת פִּ֑יךָ מֵ֝אַלְפֵ֗י זָהָ֥ב וָכָֽסֶף

verses.restored: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

familiar.text: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

modern.text: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.

original.text: יָדֶ֣יךָ עָ֭שׂוּנִי וַֽיְכוֹנְנ֑וּנִי הֲ֝בִינֵ֗נִי וְאֶלְמְדָ֥ה מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

familiar.text: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

modern.text: May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.

original.text: יְ֭רֵאֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּנִי וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ כִּ֖י לִדְבָרְךָ֣ יִחָֽלְתִּי

verses.restored: I know, O YHWH, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

familiar.text: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

modern.text: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.

original.text: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְ֭הוָה כִּי צֶ֣דֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶ֑יךָ וֶ֝אֱמוּנָ֗ה עִנִּיתָֽנִי

verses.restored: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word to thy servant.

familiar.text: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.

modern.text: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.

original.text: יְהִי נָ֣א חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְנַחֲמֵ֑נִי כְּאִמְרָתְךָ֥ לְעַבְדֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: Let thy tender mercies come to me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.

familiar.text: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.

modern.text: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.

original.text: יְבֹא֣וּנִי רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ וְאֶֽחְיֶ֑ה כִּי תֽ֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ שַֽׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי

verses.restored: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.

familiar.text: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.

modern.text: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.

original.text: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ זֵ֭דִים כִּי שֶׁ֣קֶר עִוְּת֑וּנִי אֲ֝נִ֗י אָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Let those that fear thee turn to me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

familiar.text: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

modern.text: May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies.

original.text: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לִ֣י יְרֵאֶ֑יךָ וידעו עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

familiar.text: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

modern.text: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame. KAPH

original.text: יְהִֽי לִבִּ֣י תָמִ֣ים בְּחֻקֶּ֑יךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ

verses.restored: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.

familiar.text: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.

modern.text: My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.

original.text: כָּלְתָ֣ה לִתְשׁוּעָתְךָ֣ נַפְשִׁ֑י לִדְבָרְךָ֥ יִחָֽלְתִּי

verses.restored: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

familiar.text: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

modern.text: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”

original.text: כָּל֣וּ עֵ֭ינַי לְאִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לֵ֝אמֹ֗ר מָתַ֥י תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי

verses.restored: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.

familiar.text: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.

modern.text: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.

original.text: כִּֽי הָ֭יִיתִי כְּנֹ֣אד בְּקִיט֑וֹר חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי

verses.restored: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

familiar.text: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

modern.text: How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?

original.text: כַּמָּ֥ה יְמֵֽי עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ מָתַ֬י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בְרֹדְפַ֣י מִשְׁפָּֽט

verses.restored: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.

familiar.text: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.

modern.text: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.

original.text: כָּֽרוּ לִ֣י זֵדִ֣ים שִׁיח֑וֹת אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לֹ֣א כְתוֹרָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

familiar.text: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

modern.text: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!

original.text: כָּל מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אֱמוּנָ֑ה שֶׁ֖קֶר רְדָפ֣וּנִי עָזְרֵֽנִי

verses.restored: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

familiar.text: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

modern.text: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.

original.text: כִּ֭מְעַט כִּלּ֣וּנִי בָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝אֲנִ֗י לֹא עָזַ֥בְתִּי פִקֻּודֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

familiar.text: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

modern.text: Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth. LAMEDH

original.text: כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ חַיֵּ֑נִי וְ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה עֵד֥וּת פִּֽיךָ

verses.restored: For ever, O YHWH, thy word is settled in heaven.

familiar.text: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.

modern.text: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.

original.text: לְעוֹלָ֥ם יְהוָ֑ה דְּ֝בָרְךָ֗ נִצָּ֥ב בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם

verses.restored: Thy faithfulness is to all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

familiar.text: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

modern.text: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.

original.text: לְדֹ֣ר וָ֭דֹר אֱמֽוּנָתֶ֑ךָ כּוֹנַ֥נְתָּ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וַֽתַּעֲמֹֽד

verses.restored: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.

familiar.text: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.

modern.text: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.

original.text: לְֽ֭מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְד֣וּ הַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י הַכֹּ֣ל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

familiar.text: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

modern.text: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.

original.text: לוּלֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֑י אָ֝֗ז אָבַ֥דְתִּי בְעָנְיִֽי

verses.restored: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

familiar.text: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

modern.text: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.

original.text: לְ֭עוֹלָם לֹא אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח פִּקּוּדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֥י בָ֝֗ם חִיִּיתָֽנִי

verses.restored: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

familiar.text: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

modern.text: I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.

original.text: לְֽךָ אֲ֭נִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ דָרָֽשְׁתִּי

verses.restored: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.

familiar.text: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.

modern.text: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.

original.text: לִ֤י קִוּ֣וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לְאַבְּדֵ֑נִי עֵ֝דֹתֶ֗יךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָֽן

verses.restored: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.

familiar.text: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.

modern.text: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit. MEM

original.text: לְֽכָל תִּ֭כְלָה רָאִ֣יתִי קֵ֑ץ רְחָבָ֖ה מִצְוָתְךָ֣ מְאֹֽד

verses.restored: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

familiar.text: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

modern.text: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.

original.text: מָֽה אָהַ֥בְתִּי תוֹרָתֶ֑ךָ כָּל הַ֝יּ֗וֹם הִ֣יא שִׂיחָתִֽי

verses.restored: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.

familiar.text: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.

modern.text: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.

original.text: מֵ֭אֹ֣יְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵ֣נִי מִצְוֺתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם הִיא לִֽי

verses.restored: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.

familiar.text: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.

modern.text: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.

original.text: מִכָּל מְלַמְּדַ֥י הִשְׂכַּ֑לְתִּי כִּ֥י עֵ֝דְוֺתֶ֗יךָ שִׂ֣יחָה לִֽֿי

verses.restored: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

familiar.text: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

modern.text: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.

original.text: מִזְּקֵנִ֥ים אֶתְבּוֹנָ֑ן כִּ֖י פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי

verses.restored: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

familiar.text: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

modern.text: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.

original.text: מִכָּל אֹ֣רַח רָ֭ע כָּלִ֣אתִי רַגְלָ֑י לְ֝מַ֗עַן אֶשְׁמֹ֥ר דְּבָרֶֽךָ

verses.restored: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

familiar.text: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

modern.text: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.

original.text: מִמִּשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ לֹא סָ֑רְתִּי כִּֽי אַ֝תָּ֗ה הוֹרֵתָֽנִי

verses.restored: How sweet are thy words to my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

familiar.text: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

modern.text: How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!

original.text: מַה נִּמְלְצ֣וּ לְ֭חִכִּי אִמְרָתֶ֗ךָ מִדְּבַ֥שׁ לְפִֽי

verses.restored: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

familiar.text: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

modern.text: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way. NUN

original.text: מִפִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָ֑ן עַל כֵּ֝֗ן שָׂנֵ֤אתִי כָּל אֹ֬רַח שָֽׁקֶר

verses.restored: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.

familiar.text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

notes.title: Word as lamp
notes.body: The verse belongs to the Nun stanza of the alphabetic acrostic and describes instruction as practical illumination for a path rather than abstract information.

modern.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.

original.text: נֵר לְרַגְלִ֥י דְבָרֶ֑ךָ וְ֝א֗וֹר לִנְתִיבָתִֽי

verses.restored: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

familiar.text: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

modern.text: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.

original.text: נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי וָאֲקַיֵּ֑מָה לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ

verses.restored: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O YHWH, according to thy word.

familiar.text: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.

modern.text: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.

original.text: נַעֲנֵ֥יתִי עַד מְאֹ֑ד יְ֝הוָ֗ה חַיֵּ֥נִי כִדְבָרֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O YHWH, and teach me thy judgments.

familiar.text: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.

modern.text: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.

original.text: נִדְב֣וֹת פִּ֭י רְצֵה נָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי

verses.restored: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

familiar.text: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

modern.text: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.

original.text: נַפְשִׁ֣י בְכַפִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד וְ֝תֽוֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי

verses.restored: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

familiar.text: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

modern.text: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.

original.text: נָתְנ֬וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים פַּ֣ח לִ֑י וּ֝מִפִּקּוּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א תָעִֽיתִי

verses.restored: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

familiar.text: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

modern.text: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

original.text: נָחַ֣לְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶ֣יךָ לְעוֹלָ֑ם כִּֽי שְׂשׂ֖וֹן לִבִּ֣י הֵֽמָּה

verses.restored: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even to the end.

familiar.text: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.

modern.text: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end. SAMEKH

original.text: נָטִ֣יתִי לִ֭בִּי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת חֻקֶּ֗יךָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם עֵֽקֶב

verses.restored: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.

familiar.text: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.

modern.text: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.

original.text: סֵעֲפִ֥ים שָׂנֵ֑אתִי וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ֥ אָהָֽבְתִּי

verses.restored: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

familiar.text: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

modern.text: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.

original.text: סִתְרִ֣י וּמָגִנִּ֣י אָ֑תָּה לִדְבָרְךָ֥ יִחָֽלְתִּי

verses.restored: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

familiar.text: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

modern.text: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.

original.text: סֽוּרוּ מִמֶּ֥נִּי מְרֵעִ֑ים וְ֝אֶצְּרָ֗ה מִצְוֺ֥ת אֱלֹהָֽי

verses.restored: Uphold me according to thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

familiar.text: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

modern.text: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.

original.text: סָמְכֵ֣נִי כְאִמְרָתְךָ֣ וְאֶֽחְיֶ֑ה וְאַל תְּ֝בִישֵׁ֗נִי מִשִּׂבְרִֽי

verses.restored: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect to thy statutes continually.

familiar.text: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

modern.text: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.

original.text: סְעָדֵ֥נִי וְאִוָּשֵׁ֑עָה וְאֶשְׁעָ֖ה בְחֻקֶּ֣יךָ תָמִֽיד

verses.restored: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.

familiar.text: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.

modern.text: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.

original.text: סָ֭לִיתָ כָּל שׁוֹגִ֣ים מֵחֻקֶּ֑יךָ כִּי שֶׁ֝֗קֶר תַּרְמִיתָֽם

verses.restored: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

familiar.text: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

modern.text: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.

original.text: סִגִ֗ים הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ כָל רִשְׁעֵי אָ֑רֶץ לָ֝כֵ֗ן אָהַ֥בְתִּי עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

familiar.text: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

modern.text: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments. AYIN

original.text: סָמַ֣ר מִפַּחְדְּךָ֣ בְשָׂרִ֑י וּֽמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ יָרֵֽאתִי

verses.restored: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

familiar.text: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

modern.text: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.

original.text: עָ֭שִׂיתִי מִשְׁפָּ֣ט וָצֶ֑דֶק בַּל תַּ֝נִּיחֵ֗נִי לְעֹֽשְׁקָֽי

verses.restored: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

familiar.text: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

modern.text: Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.

original.text: עֲרֹ֣ב עַבְדְּךָ֣ לְט֑וֹב אַֽל יַעַשְׁקֻ֥נִי זֵדִֽים

verses.restored: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

familiar.text: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

modern.text: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.

original.text: עֵ֭ינַי כָּל֣וּ לִֽישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ וּלְאִמְרַ֥ת צִדְקֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Deal with thy servant according to thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

familiar.text: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

modern.text: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.

original.text: עֲשֵׂ֖ה עִם עַבְדְּךָ֥ כְחַסְדֶּ֗ךָ וְחֻקֶּ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי

verses.restored: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

familiar.text: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

modern.text: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.

original.text: עַבְדְּךָ אָ֥נִי הֲבִינֵ֑נִי וְ֝אֵדְעָ֗ה עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: It is time for thee, YHWH, to work: for they have made void thy law.

familiar.text: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.

modern.text: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.

original.text: עֵ֭ת לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה הֵ֝פֵ֗רוּ תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

familiar.text: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

modern.text: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.

original.text: עַל כֵּ֭ן אָהַ֣בְתִּי מִצְוֺתֶ֑יךָ מִזָּהָ֥ב וּמִפָּֽז

verses.restored: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.

familiar.text: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.

modern.text: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way. PE

original.text: עַל כֵּ֤ן כָּל פִּקּ֣וּדֵי כֹ֣ל יִשָּׁ֑רְתִּי כָּל אֹ֖רַח שֶׁ֣קֶר שָׂנֵֽאתִי

verses.restored: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

familiar.text: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

modern.text: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.

original.text: פְּלָא֥וֹת עֵדְוֺתֶ֑יךָ עַל כֵּ֝֗ן נְצָרָ֥תַם נַפְשִֽׁי

verses.restored: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding to the simple.

familiar.text: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

modern.text: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.

original.text: פֵּ֖תַח דְּבָרֶ֥יךָ יָאִ֗יר מֵבִ֥ין פְּתָיִֽים

verses.restored: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

familiar.text: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

modern.text: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.

original.text: פִּֽי פָ֭עַרְתִּי וָאֶשְׁאָ֑פָה כִּ֖י לְמִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ יָאָֽבְתִּי

verses.restored: Look thou upon me, and be merciful to me, as thou usest to do to those that love thy name.

familiar.text: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

modern.text: Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.

original.text: פְּנֵה אֵלַ֥י וְחָנֵּ֑נִי כְּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט לְאֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

familiar.text: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

modern.text: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.

original.text: פְּ֭עָמַי הָכֵ֣ן בְּאִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ וְֽאַל תַּשְׁלֶט בִּ֥י כָל אָֽוֶן

verses.restored: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

familiar.text: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

modern.text: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.

original.text: פְּ֭דֵנִי מֵעֹ֣שֶׁק אָדָ֑ם וְ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

familiar.text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

modern.text: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.

original.text: פָּ֭נֶיךָ הָאֵ֣ר בְּעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝לַמְּדֵ֗נִי אֶת חֻקֶּֽיךָ

verses.restored: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

familiar.text: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

modern.text: My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed. TZADE

original.text: פַּלְגֵי מַ֭יִם יָרְד֣וּ עֵינָ֑י עַ֝֗ל לֹא שָׁמְר֥וּ תוֹרָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Righteous art thou, O YHWH, and upright are thy judgments.

familiar.text: Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.

modern.text: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.

original.text: צַדִּ֣יק אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝יָשָׁ֗ר מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.

familiar.text: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.

modern.text: The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.

original.text: צִ֭וִּיתָ צֶ֣דֶק עֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ וֶֽאֱמוּנָ֥ה מְאֹֽד

verses.restored: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

familiar.text: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

modern.text: My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words.

original.text: צִמְּתַ֥תְנִי קִנְאָתִ֑י כִּֽי שָׁכְח֖וּ דְבָרֶ֣יךָ צָרָֽי

verses.restored: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

familiar.text: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

modern.text: Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.

original.text: צְרוּפָ֖ה אִמְרָתְךָ֥ מְאֹ֗ד וְֽעַבְדְּךָ֥ אֲהֵבָֽהּ

verses.restored: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.

familiar.text: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.

modern.text: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.

original.text: צָעִ֣יר אָנֹכִ֣י וְנִבְזֶ֑ה פִּ֝קֻּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי

verses.restored: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.

familiar.text: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.

modern.text: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.

original.text: צִדְקָתְךָ֣ צֶ֣דֶק לְעוֹלָ֑ם וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ֥ אֱמֶֽת

verses.restored: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.

familiar.text: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.

modern.text: Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight.

original.text: צַר וּמָצ֥וֹק מְצָא֑וּנִי מִ֝צְוֺתֶ֗יךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי

verses.restored: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

familiar.text: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

modern.text: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. KOPH

original.text: צֶ֖דֶק עֵדְוֺתֶ֥יךָ לְעוֹלָ֗ם הֲבִינֵ֥נִי וְאֶחְיֶֽה

verses.restored: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O YHWH: I will keep thy statutes.

familiar.text: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.

modern.text: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes.

original.text: קָרָ֣אתִי בְכָל לֵ֭ב עֲנֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֗ה חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶצֹּֽרָה

verses.restored: I cried to thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
